summary: For pfsense/pfsense, gate the run before checkout or deployment unless the host can satisfy the official appliance path: FreeBSD-oriented build/install workflow plus a supported VM or physical target with enough disk and privilege.

During the WSO2 API Manager Docker build, host proxy variables can break Ubuntu apt metadata fetches with 502s, so apt should run with proxy env removed while the later GitHub release zip download can still use the proxy.
quick_checks: docker build output shows apt-get update completing without 502s.

summary: For BigBlueButton 3.0, gate the run before deployment unless the host matches the official path: clean dedicated Ubuntu 22.04, root access, en_US.UTF-8 locale, sufficient RAM, and a real hostname for HTTPS/WebRTC.

For ceph/ceph, do not improvise an ad hoc Docker deployment when the official local paths are cephadm bootstrap or a full source-built vstart cluster; first verify root or passwordless sudo for cephadm, otherwise expect the fallback to require a heavyweight source build.
quick_checks: Confirm whether the intended path is cephadm bootstrap or a full source-built vstart cluster before fetching large source trees.
If `http_proxy` or `https_proxy` is set, avoid assuming a Ceph repo clone will finish within the normal deployment budget.

summary: For JetBrains/intellij-community, gate the run before any large checkout unless the host can satisfy the official desktop build path: GUI-capable IntelliJ IDEA, JBR 25, at least 8 GB RAM, and disk headroom beyond standard runner-class capacity.

A local rebuild of `Piwigo/piwigo-docker` can false-fail on a transient Docker Hub auth-token EOF while pulling `library/alpine:latest`; when the official prebuilt `piwigo/piwigo:latest` image path is available, prefer it instead of spending retries on the cold rebuild.

When building Go CLIs like okteto/okteto from a detached release-tag checkout on a host without Go installed, use a Go builder container with a non-login shell and `-buildvcs=false`; otherwise you can lose `go` from PATH inside the container or hit VCS stamping failures before runtime verification even begins.
quick_checks: Use `go build -buildvcs=false ...` for detached-tag source builds.

summary: For ISPConfig, stop before deployment when the runner lacks root or passwordless sudo, because the official path is a full-host bootstrap for web, mail, DNS, FTP, and database services rather than a normal app-only install.
quick_checks: Confirm the official docs still recommend the autoinstaller/Perfect Server path.

summary: For LibreOffice/core, verify host suitability before any large checkout: the official paths are a heavyweight Linux build or an even heavier WASM cross-build.
quick_checks: Verify whether the target is the desktop source tree or a lighter downstream deployment artifact.
Require noninteractive privilege for documented package installation on Linux builds.
Treat the WASM path as a separate heavyweight branch, not a fallback for a weak host.

summary: For Garden local-kubernetes deployments on this host, validate local Kubernetes control-plane viability before spending time on project-level remediation: both kind and minikube can fail during bootstrap with in-container systemd errors when fs.inotify.max_user_instances is too low and no passwordless sudo is available to raise it.
quick_checks: docker logs <control-plane-container> | rg 'Failed to create control group inotify object|Failed to allocate manager object'
minikube start output shows the same inotify-related PID 1 failure after kicbase download.

summary: Repository-snapshot Keycloak builds can false-fail on transient Maven Central TLS handshake errors during large first-time dependency resolution, so treat one-off plugin-resolution failures as network noise first, not immediate project breakage.
quick_checks: If runtime deployment can follow the official stable image/distribution path, do not let a transient repository snapshot build handshake failure block business-app delivery.

summary: MinecraftForge 26.1.2 source builds should be gated before execution unless the host can provide both a Gradle-supported runtime JDK and the project JDK 25 toolchain, full git tag history for changelog generation, and materially more free RAM/disk than a runner-class machine.
quick_checks: `JAVA_HOME=<jdk21> ./gradlew --version` should succeed before the real build.
`git tag --list 64.0` should return the expected tag before :createChangelog runs.
Require materially more headroom than `free -h` showing about 1.7 GiB available and `df -h /` showing about 2.5 GiB free.

summary: For truenas/middleware, do not treat the repository as a standalone deployable app: upstream points to the broader TrueNAS build flow, the public scale-build repo is historical/deprecated, the expected product includes the separate TrueNAS Web UI, and small generic Debian hosts without the TrueNAS package ecosystem will fail before meaningful startup.
quick_checks: rg -n 'To build this source repository' README.md

summary: For opnsense/core, do not treat a generic Linux Docker host as sufficient for a valid official deployment unless it can either build on stock FreeBSD as root or run the official appliance image with real externally publishable VM networking.
quick_checks: Official docs say `core` is the GUI/system package and `tools` builds full images on stock FreeBSD 14.3 as root.
Serial console can show a healthy OPNsense boot while `curl --noproxy '*' -k https://127.0.0.1:<port>/` still times out; treat that as a hard failure.

summary: For osTicket on php:8.4-apache, gate the build on gd, intl, mbstring, mysqli, pdo_mysql, xml, and zip, and prefer the bookworm variant when the newer base image breaks extension setup.
quick_checks: docker compose exec -T app php -m | rg -qx 'gd|intl|mbstring|mysqli|pdo_mysql|xml|zip'
Review build logs for missing libonig-dev or libxml2-dev when mbstring or xml fail to compile.

summary: The upstream unoconv script is not a drop-in fit for Ubuntu 24.04 defaults: it expects a python shebang target and still imports distutils, so a naive Python 3.12 runtime fails before the listener can start.
quick_checks: docker compose logs should not show '/usr/bin/env: python: No such file or directory'.
docker compose exec -T unoconv unoconv --version should not fail with ModuleNotFoundError: distutils.

summary: For truenas/middleware, stop before ad hoc containerization when the public docs route builds through the TrueNAS build/image system or an already-built TrueNAS VM, because the package requires many unavailable truenas-specific dependencies and does not have an official generic-host standalone deployment path.
quick_checks: `docker run --rm debian:12 bash -lc "apt-get update >/dev/null && apt-cache search '^truenas-'"`
Inspect `src/middlewared/debian/control` for `truenas-*` package dependencies and `src/middlewared/middlewared/etc_files/local/nginx/nginx.conf.mako` for `/ui/` web UI expectations.

summary: For Zimbra/zm-mailbox, do not treat the repository as a standalone deployable app; upstream documentation routes real installs through the full Zimbra Collaboration host installer, which requires a supported OS, working sudo/root, and a license.
quick_checks: `curl -L https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Zimbra/zm-mailbox/master/README.md` should describe source, not a standalone installer.
`curl -L https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Zimbra/zinstaller/master/supported-os-installer.sh | rg check_sudoer` should confirm the privilege gate.
`sudo -n true` must succeed before pursuing the installer path on this host.
